title: openclaude: a provider-flexible coding agent runtime
friendlyTitle: Run a coding agent with different AI providers
summary: openclaude is a TypeScript coding-agent project designed to run across environments and model providers. It is actively maintained, with a recent release and broad community participation.
friendlySummary: openclaude is an open-source coding helper that can work in different environments and with different models.
whyItMatters: Developers can use it to experiment with agentic coding without tying the workflow to one model vendor. Its provider support also makes comparative testing and fallback configurations easier.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to test coding-agent workflows without depending on only one AI company.
